name: ChatGPT and the OpenAI Platform for Professionals
description: A practical, current tour of ChatGPT as a professional tool: choosing a plan and model, prompting well, analyzing files, researching with citations, using images and voice, organizing work in projects and memory, connecting apps and plugins, delegating multi-step work to ChatGPT Work, and knowing which admin and privacy controls matter. Ends with clear guidance on moving a workflow to the OpenAI API.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: ChatGPT and the OpenAI Platform for Professionals

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 15 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
